name: Towel
description: One towel line sold in several sizes: face cloth, hand towel, bath towel and bath sheet, chosen as options on one listing.

name: Floor lamp
description: Tall lamp that stands on the floor beside furniture, lighting the room directly or upward to the ceiling.

name: Work light
description: Portable light for lighting a job, clamped, hung or held; corded or cordless.

name: Binoculars
description: Binoculars sold as one item with the prism type, Porro or roof, as an option.

name: Barometer
description: A barometer sold as one item, with a mercury cistern, angled mercury or aneroid movement as the option.

name: Lithograph
description: A lithograph sold as one item, printed from a stone or from a plate through an offset press, chosen as an option on the listing.

name: TENS/EMS unit
description: A pulse unit with skin pads sold as one item, with nerve stimulation (TENS) or muscle stimulation (EMS) as the mode.

name: Domain name
description: One domain name registered under the TLD you choose: open generic, country-code or restricted, picked as options in the registrar search.

name: Keyboard switches
description: Loose keyboard switches sold on one listing, chosen by feel: linear, tactile bump or audible click.

name: Meat thermometer
description: One food thermometer sold as a hand-held instant-read probe or a leave-in probe with an alarm, differing by feature.

name: Top-load washing machine
description: Top-loading washer sold in one range; the variants differ by wash mechanism, a central agitator or a low impeller disc.

name: Kitchen bin
description: One kitchen bin range; the variants differ by how the lid opens: foot pedal, motion sensor, or other lids.

name: Clothes airer
description: One clothes airer listing; the variants differ by power and form: heated, rotary, or other folding airers.

name: Dehumidifier
description: One room dehumidifier sold by water-removal capacity, from small mini units to larger portable units.

name: Security camera
description: A home security camera, fixed or with a motor that pans and tilts it.

name: Baby gate
description: A stair or doorway gate; variants differ by how it fixes: screwed to the wall, held by pressure, or retracting into a housing.

name: Padlock
description: A key or combination padlock; variants differ by shackle, either open above the body or shrouded by it.

name: Pool filter
description: Pool filters sold by filter media: sand, pleated cartridge or diatomaceous earth grids.

name: Riding mower
description: Riding mowers differing by size, duty class and deck setup, from ride-on mowers to lawn tractors.

name: Self-tapping screw
description: One sheet-metal screw line sold with or without a drill point, chosen by head, driver, diameter and length.
